'''Premiere Unlimited''' is the 2nd expansion of Star Wars CCG.
It is published by Decipher in 1995 and consists of 324 cards. This set is the white-border reprint of Premiere Limited.

The Premiere Unlimited cards are the same 324-card pool as Premiere Limited, with white borders. Unlimited edition expansion and starter decks followed the limited print run (Decipher product library: February 1996).
